A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a new unsupervised machine learning method for NMT, which combines SMT with NMT and achieves better performance than either of them alone.
we propose to use SMT as posterior regularization in unsupervised NBT, and we show that it works well and achieves new state-of-the-art performance on the WMT16 translation task.

The main takeaway from our work is that
SMT can be used as posterior regularization to guide the training process of NMT, and this idea may be applicable to other weakly supervised learning scenarios.
, SMT can be used as posterior regularizations of NMT, and the two models are mutually beneficial.
